editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer certification by reviewing its direct successor and core platform requirements.
editorial.overview: The SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer certification exam, administered by Snowflake, is now retired and no longer available for scheduling. Its verified successor is DEA-C02. The linear exam format historically featured 65 questions, a duration of 115 minutes, and a passing score of 65. Candidates evaluated data engineering concepts across 5 distinct domains.
editorial.who_should_take: Data engineers and advanced Snowflake professionals seeking to validate technical proficiency. Candidates should focus study efforts on the successor DEA-C02, as the current program requires transition planning.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not attempt to schedule or study for the retired exam code, as it is retired. Focus all preparation efforts entirely on DEA-C02. Transfer your knowledge of bulk loading, continuous loading with Snowpipe, virtual warehouse performance tuning, and access control directly to your studies for the successor exam today.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers standard data movement mechanisms in Snowflake, focusing heavily on bulk loading with COPY INTO, continuous loading using Snowpipe and Snowpipe Streaming, and integrating with external cloud storage stages securely.
study_focus: Implementing bulk and continuous loading strategies
Handling data ingestion via Kafka and streaming

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses intensely on optimizing query execution and warehouse performance through resource sizing, memory management, query acceleration, and effectively managing virtual warehouse queues to ensure optimal enterprise computing efficiency.

This domain deals extensively with storage management and data protection features built into Snowflake, including time travel, failsafe capabilities, and handling external tables for modern cloud-based data lakes effectively.
study_focus: Utilizing external tables for cloud storage

domain_guidance.summary: This domain addresses specific security principles within Snowflake, focusing deeply on access control hierarchies, user privileges, and object level security configurations required to protect sensitive corporate assets during standard operations.

This domain covers broad data governance and privacy practices, ensuring proper handling of data objects and strict compliance with organizational requirements and regulatory standards within the platform ecosystem.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because the previous version is retired, it cannot be scheduled on exam day. Candidates must register for the successor exam, DEA-C02, which follows a linear format and requires meeting all current testing policies.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam traditionally consists of 65 questions presented in a linear format. Question types include multiple choice and multiple select options for candidates taking the test.
The passing score for the historical exam is 65. Candidates must achieve this specific score out of the total questions administered during the linear test session.
The total duration of the exam is 115 minutes. Candidates must complete all required questions within this strictly allocated timeframe during their scheduled test session.
The standard price for registering for the certification exam is $250. This mandatory fee applies to all registrations for the official certification program administered by Snowflake.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official Snowflake documentation, exam guides, and verified historical metadata regarding the retirement and succession of the certification program.
